note: Every game system v0.1 touches. depends_* reference other sheets by name.

rows.name: online_guard
rows.what_it_does: turns the whole mod off while a network session is running (story mode only)

rows.name: xr_session
rows.what_it_does: opens an OpenXR session on GTA's D3D11 device, reads headset + controller poses

rows.name: stereo_aer
rows.what_it_does: alternate-eye rendering: odd frames left eye, even frames right eye, each sent to its eye

rows.name: head_camera
rows.what_it_does: scripted first-person camera at the head bone, rotated by the headset

rows.name: arm_follow
rows.what_it_does: each arm's hand is pulled to its controller's position with arm IK

rows.name: weapon_aim
rows.what_it_does: right controller's aim ray picks the target; trigger fires at it

rows.name: controller_input
rows.what_it_does: thumbsticks and buttons feed GTA's own controls (on foot and in vehicles)
